target_reference: 0.8710 September macro average precision; historically inspected
selection_metric: August macro average precision; never September

tail_guard.risk: mean softplus(negative logit minus positive logit) over all positives and top 20*positive_count negatives per bank/calendar task
tail_guard.history: full June-July training history; memory rebuilt for each candidate; no holdout risk
tail_guard.acceptance: largest step satisfying every nonempty two-class bank/task constraint

promotion: Require improvement over matched continuation across seeds; keep round zero eligible and retain failed candidates
novelty: Unverified specific combination; federated line search, ranking losses, gradient correction and continual replay have prior art
test_policy: No new September evaluation in this study. Untouched later data required for confirmatory improvement beyond 87.10%.
